title: Interactive Tutorial & Fluid Portal Animations
message: GabAI v0.3.1 introduces an interactive guided tour system and fluid animations to the Administrative Web Portal.
changelog:
• Web Administrative Portal: Interactive guided tour system for Super Admin (SDO) and School Admin
• Spotlight Tour Engine: Viewport-clamped floating guide with morphing spotlight frame
• Fluid Animation Suite: Tab slide transitions, card hover lifts, modal pop-ins, and toast animations
• Multi-Tier Governance: School Matrix, SDO invite generator, and administrative remarks drawer
